text:
maria: quick heads-up — product wants a single dashboard showing Hosted + Dedicated GPU headroom + queue behavior for SMs. need signals and an owner to stitch runtime + infra inputs.

kevin: tagging infra owners — we can export per-host SM occupancy, sm_memory_used_bytes, sm_queue_depth for each pool. but need to agree on labels (pool_id, deployment_mode=hosted|dedicated, region).

ashley: runtime side: we already surface kv_cache_hit_ratio and active_sequences per SM. can add sm_queue_length and per-request enqueue latency. question: do you want sampled traces or aggregate histograms?

maria: aggregated timeseries to start (1m, 5m). we'll add traces later for regressions. key asks: consistent label set, retention 90d for dashboards, 1d for high-res raw, and a rollout plan so customers on Dedicated don't see noise during canary.

jordan: from Console/UX: the dashboard must let product teams toggle by pool and compare hosted vs dedicated side-by-side. also want a quota burn indicator (tokens/sec) tied to pool capacity.

kevin: label proposal: {metric, pool_id, pool_type, region, instance_type, model_family}. pool_type = "hosted"|"dedicated". keep cardinality low: avoid model_family if too many variants.

ashley: agree on pool_type + pool_id + region. instance_type helps for tail-latency investigations. we'll emit quantiles for queue latency (p50/p95/p99) and gauge for queue_depth.

maria: perfect. can we also expose sm_total_memory_bytes and sm_free_memory_bytes so we can compute normalized memory occupancy in dashboards?

kevin: yep. infra will add sm_memory_total_bytes and sm_memory_used_bytes. will also add an export tag origin=runtime/infra to know the producer.

ashley: runtime can set origin=runtime. one nuance: for Dedicated we sometimes run with pinned allocation per customer — we'll include customer_tier label for dedicated only (enterprise/standard). avoids leaking PII.

jordan: UX note: when comparing pools, we want a computed "headroom" series: (total_slots - used_slots) / total_slots. Can the metrics team precompute a total_slots per pool?

kevin: infra can export pool_total_slots as a gauge with pool_id. we'll keep it low-cardinality and update on scaling events.

maria: rollout plan suggestion: emit all metrics behind a feature-flag for 48 hours in perf cluster, then a 1-week canary in hosted region-us-east-1, then flip to prod. during canary, Console should default to historical mode and hide new alerts.

ashley: runtime-side will gate high-cardinality labels behind flag to avoid Prometheus explosion. we'll also throttle scrape frequency for dedicated pools initially.

kevin: note on retention/cost: high-res (15s) only for 72h, 1m for 30d, 5m for 90d. if product wants 90d 1m we can do that.

maria: agreed. owners? infra owns pool_total_slots + memory_* metrics. runtime owns queue_depth + queue_latency + occupancy. platform (maria) owns dashboard composition and alert definitions.

jordan: UX owner for dashboard = jordan. will draft wire with toggles and comparison panel by tomorrow.

kevin: I'll create the prometheus job + Grafana datasources PR and assign to ashley for validation.

infra-bot: deploy-plan created: prometheus-exporter/gpu-metrics v2.3 -> canary region-us-east-1 at 2026-03-25T02:00Z.

sre-oncall: quick reminder: add runbook entries for "SM queue growth" and "SM mem pressure" with paging thresholds. we should avoid noisy pages during canary.

maria: good point. runbook draft in #eng-oncall, will link in the dashboard doc.

ashley: small implementation note: metric names we'll use (draft):
```
sm_queue_depth_gauge
sm_queue_enqueue_latency_seconds_bucket
sm_memory_total_bytes
sm_memory_used_bytes
sm_occupancy_ratio (if preferrable, computed)
pool_total_slots
```

kevin: sounds good. I'll add label list to the PR: pool_id, pool_type, region, instance_type, customer_tier (dedicated only), origin.

maria: timeline: wire tomorrow, infra/runtime PRs by EOD Friday, canary next Thu. if anyone has blockers ping me. :thumbsup:

jordan: ack, will post wire + sample queries.

kevin: ack, starting work.

ashley: ack, will add feature flags and throttling.

maria: thanks all — closing loop here. we'll keep updates in this thread and the dashboard doc. :)
